summary: The only trust boundary is CLI argv in src/playtest/cli.ts. --size is still checked with the strict ^[0-9]+$ pattern and a range check, now 2..10. Anything outside the range, or non-digit input such as '1', '0', '-2', '2.0' or '1e1', gives SIZE_ERROR. --button is still bounded to 1..size, so with --size 2 only buttons 1 and 2 are accepted. The engine's validate() in src/engine/hand.ts fails closed for any other seat count (RangeError) and still checks duplicate seats, button membership and the 52-card deck before createHand runs. The heads-up blind change only picks sb and bb from seats that have already been validated, and indexes dealOrder[0] or [0..1] when n >= 2, so it has no out-of-bounds read or undefined seat. Resource use is unchanged: --hands is still capped at 1e9 and heads-up hands are shorter. There are no new dependencies, network calls, secrets, file I/O or randomness, and shuffles are still seeded from the replay code. The gates passed: test, lint and typecheck. No findings.
